vita.title: Denis Simon
vita.description: The biography and artistic journey of painter Denis Simon.
vita.heading:
Capturing
the seen.
vita.artistStatement: I paint to preserve the beauty I find in the world — emotional moments, natural light, and the subtle details that often go unnoticed. For over a decade, this passion has driven my work, with every canvas presenting new challenges and further refining my craft.
vita.biography: Born in Kazakhstan and raised in Germany, art has shaped my perspective since childhood. I am a self-taught artist, having honed my techniques through years of dedicated practice. My work spans diverse styles — from vast landscapes and atmospheric compositions to portraits, wildlife, and abstract pieces — each reflecting my personal journey and a commitment to portraying nature's true essence.
vita.professionalLife: By day, I work as an IT Systems Architect. My creative passion comes to life in my studio in Oldenburg, Northern Germany. This balance between analytical problem-solving and artistic expression defines both my professional and personal life.

commissions.title: Denis Simon
commissions.description: Commission a custom acrylic painting — landscape or animal portrait — by Denis Simon.
commissions.label: Commissions
commissions.heading:
Your vision.
Brought to life with detail.
commissions.intro: Places that hold meaning. A pet you love. I accept a limited number of private commissions each year. Every piece is an original acrylic on canvas, signed, varnished, and crafted to last for generations.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.body: We start with a conversation. You describe the subject, the setting, and the mood. I listen.

steps.title: Reference
steps.body: You share your photographs — ideally your own. Together, we decide on the composition and focus.

steps.title: Proposal
steps.body: I provide a written proposal covering size, color palette, timeline, and pricing. Nothing begins until you are completely ready.

steps.title: Creation
steps.body: The painting process takes six to twelve weeks. You will receive exactly two progress updates to see your piece come to life.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.body: The finished canvas is varnished, signed, and shipped with full insurance to any destination worldwide.

commissions.ctaText: Send me a message with your ideas — subject, references, desired dimensions, and timeline. I’ll get back to you with a proposal and the next steps.
